name: Modified Vector Quantization (LBG variant)
definition: A vector quantization algorithm that uses a distortion-based splitting technique to generate the initial codebook, avoiding the time-consuming nearest neighbor searches of the standard LBG algorithm and solving the empty cell problem.
summary: Modified Vector Quantization is a vector quantization algorithm that uses distortion-based splitting to generate an initial codebook, avoiding empty cells and speeding up initialization compared to standard LBG.
